crossRefs.note: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod…
As she rode on her donkey, and came down by the covert of the mountain, that behold, David and his men came down toward…
He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.
After he had eaten bread, and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

translations.web: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
translations.bsb: Then she saddled the donkey and told her servant, “Drive onward; do not slow the pace for me unless I tell you.”
translations.kjv: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
translations.asv: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slacken me not the riding, except I bid thee.
